from typing import Annotated

from fastapi import Depends

from src.configs import get_logger
from src.libs.decorators.transactional_decorator import Transactional
from src.modules.tasks.ports.output import ITaskRepoDep
from src.modules.tasks.presenter.dtos import CreateTaskRequestDto, TaskResponseDto

logger = get_logger(__name__)


class CreateTaskUsecase:
    def __init__(self, task_repo: ITaskRepoDep):
        self.task_repo = task_repo

    @Transactional
    async def execute(self, dto: CreateTaskRequestDto) -> TaskResponseDto:
        task = self.task_repo.create(dto.to_entity())
        logger.info("task created", extra={"task_id": str(task.id)})
        return TaskResponseDto.from_entity(task)


CreateTaskUsecaseDep = Annotated[CreateTaskUsecase, Depends(CreateTaskUsecase)]

import os
import uuid
from itertools import count
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlmodel import Session

from src.modules.shared.infrastructure.models import TaskModel

MISSING = str(uuid.uuid4())
SEQUENCE = count(1)


def _seed_task(**overrides: Any) -> TaskModel:
    n = next(SEQUENCE)
    values: dict[str, Any] = dict(overrides)
    values.setdefault("title", f"Task title {n}")
    engine = create_engine(os.environ["DB_URL"])
    with Session(engine) as session:
        model = TaskModel(**values)
        session.add(model)
        session.commit()
        session.refresh(model)
    engine.dispose()
    return model


def _payload() -> dict[str, Any]:
    n = next(SEQUENCE)
    return {
        "title": f"Task title {n}",
        "status": ['TODO', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'DONE'][n % 3],
    }


def test_create_task__ok(client):
    payload = _payload()

    response = client.post("/tasks", json=payload)

    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text
    body = response.json()
    assert body["title"] == payload["title"]
    assert body["status"] == payload["status"]


def test_create_task__invalid(client):
    assert client.post("/tasks", json={}).status_code == 422
    assert client.post("/tasks", json={**_payload(), "unexpectedField": 1}).status_code == 422


def test_list_tasks__ok(client):
    first, second = _seed_task(), _seed_task()

    body = client.get("/tasks").json()

    assert body["total"] == 2
    assert {item["id"] for item in body["items"]} == {str(first.id), str(second.id)}


def test_list_tasks__pagination(client):
    for _ in range(3):
        _seed_task()

    page = client.get("/tasks", params={"limit": 2, "offset": 2}).json()

    assert page["total"] == 3 and page["limit"] == 2 and page["offset"] == 2
    assert len(page["items"]) == 1
